home.title: What should we watch tonight?
home.subtitle: Open the main screen on a TV or computer and let everyone scan the QR code with their phone. No accounts, no sign-up — just swipe.
home.hostHint: Open the main screen on a big screen everyone can see.
home.step1Body: Create a room on the computer connected to the TV; a QR code and a 4-letter code appear.
home.step2Body: Everyone joins from their phone with a nickname and an emoji.
home.step3Body: Everyone picks their own taste and swipes the same deck at their own pace.
home.step4Body: After a countdown the most loved movie is revealed on the main screen.
home.privacy: Privacy: no accounts, no tracking cookies, no analytics, no ads. Rooms only live in memory and are deleted when closed.
